payload.title: Guideline files editor in the console (replace the structured-fields form)
payload.description: The console's writing guidelines panel still edits structured fields (voice, tone, lexicon, glossary...) and the server turns them into fixed-name guideline files, keeping rule files (PPY-1d5c43). Replace it with a files editor: list the set's guideline files, edit each file's front matter and body, add and remove rule files, show each file's derived check and severity, with Accept/Reject vocabulary and Lucide icons. Same operations (guidelines_get returns files, guidelines_save takes files). Decision: Ryan/PO 2026-11-16, separate later task.
